disambiguate.prompt:
Inspect the parent category of the reference images of '{class_name}'. Output exactly one word category. Never output as same as input. Never use vague categories such as object, item, thing, entity, miscellaneous, or product. Output no labels, arrows, or explanations. Examples show the format: elephant
 mammal

describe.vlm_prompt:
Describe the image in exactly one realistic sentence using '{name} ({category})'.Output only the sentence. Ignore plural forms of class names and category. Dont change orignal class name and (category). 

example: A photo of European fire salamander (amphibian) resting on damp moss, with black skin and vivid yellow markings, in a shaded forest scene.
 
Use this form: A photo of a {name} ({category}) [doing/done], with [distinctive features], in [specific scene].

extend.extension_prompt:
Generate exactly {number} new realistic descriptions for '{name} ({category})'. Every sentence must contain the literal text '{name} ({category})' unchanged. Do not repeat any supplied description, and vary your descriptions with different [doing/done], [distinctive features], and [specific scene].

Return a numbered list from 1 to {number}.  Output only the sentence for each list item. Use this form: A photo of a {name} ({category}) [doing/done], with [distinctive features], in [specific scene].
extend.determine_prompt: From the provided description list, determine which sentences are unrealistic or reduce diversity. Output one 1-based sequence number per line for every sentence that needs reflection. Do not output anything else. If all sentences are good, return 'apple'.
extend.reflection_prompt:
Rewrite exactly {number} supplied descriptions for the complete class semantics '{name} ({category})'. Every result must contain the literal text '{name} ({category})' unchanged, remain photorealistic and plausible, and be distinct from the supplied descriptions and from every other result.

One-shot example:
Class semantics: European fire salamander (amphibian)
Output:
1. A photo of a European fire salamander (amphibian) emerging beside a shallow stream, with bright yellow patches on smooth black skin, in natural overcast light.

Return a numbered list.  Output only the sentence for each list item. Use this form: A photo of a {name} ({category}) [doing/done], with [distinctive features], in [specific scene].
extend.system_prompt: You generate diverse, realistic image descriptions for image-classification datasets and follow exact output formats.

generate.reflect_one_prompt: Rewrite the description as one realistic sentence for the complete class semantics '{name} ({category})'. The literal text '{name} ({category})' must remain unchanged. Use the form: A photo of a {name} ({category}) [doing/done], with [distinctive features], in [specific scene]. Output only the sentence.
